description.p: Private messages, calls, files and a password vault, encrypted on your own devices and reached through Tor.

ul.li: Encrypted file storage and a password vault

description.p: Free accounts can now send files and voice messages in chats, up to 25 MB each. If Tor is blocked where you are, Settings › Network routing › Bridges connects through Snowflake, obfs4 or bridges you enter yourself: still Tor, with a hidden way in. Video calls stay sharp when the connection drops packets, and the desktop sends 720p video when the connection allows it.

Stays reachable when the onion address is down: the app now switches to the backup route within seconds instead of saying Tor isn't connected, remembers it for the next start, and signs you in once Tor connects. Files can now show pictures, text, tables, audio, video and PDFs inside the app, and sign-in is protected against strangers locking you out.

A Stories studio: record voice stories, edit photos, make collages, use templates and animated text, and choose how long a story stays up. Large files also go through the backup route, and Tor's libraries are updated.
Ready for per-device encryption keys in chats, channels and communities, and for Stories protected by those keys. Each turns on once RedVault switches it on for your account.

A backup route: when Tor can't reach the onion service, the app still connects through Tor, to the website, with every request sealed so that only our server can read it. You can turn it off in Settings.
A cleaner layout: the side bar runs the full height of the window, and Privacy and Stories have left the side bar and Settings.
